purpose: Verified dry-matter-basis composition records (forage/feed databases). Not shown as per-100 g fresh values.
policy: Values are stored exactly as published, with unit, n, SD and range where given.
Values marked by the source as equation-derived (*) are excluded.
No conversion from dry matter to fresh weight is performed or implied.
Each record is one source variant (part + state); fresh and hay are separate records.
Composition data never change feeding verdicts.
